mapper.select: select id,pname,price,image_url,stock,purchase_limit as purchaseLimit,status,create_time,update_time,detail_id from product where pname like concat('%',#{pname},'%')
mapper.update: update product set pname = #{pname}, price = #{price}, image_url = #{imageUrl}, stock = #{stock}, purchase_limit = #{purchaseLimit}, status = #{status}, update_time = now(), detail_id = #{detailId} where id = #{id}
mapper.insert: insert into product(pname, price, image_url, stock, purchase_limit, status, create_time, update_time, detail_id) values(#{pname}, #{price}, #{imageUrl}, #{stock}, #{purchaseLimit}, #{status}, now(), now(), #{detailId})
